entities.title: Schengen Visa Processing Times and Fees
entities.summary: Overview of processing times and fees for Schengen visa applications at German missions in Pakistan. Standard processing time is fourteen calendar days from initial application.
entities.processing_time: fourteen (14) calendar days starting at initial application
important_notes: Visa fees are due in PKR at the current exchange rate
Payment must be made in cash at the counter at both Islamabad Embassy and Karachi Consulate-General

entities.title: Long-term National Visa (Category D) Fees and Processing
entities.summary: Fee and processing time information for long-term (category D) national visas issued at German missions in Pakistan. Processing times vary depending on the purpose of stay and quality of application.
entities.processing_time: highly vary and depend on the reason of long-term stay as well as the quality of the application and submitted supporting documents
entities.application_fee: €75.00; Family reunion for children age 0-17: €37.50; Dependents of EU citizens: exempt
important_notes: Visa fees are due in PKR at the current exchange rate
Payment must be made in cash at the counter

extra_information.remonstration_procedure: Abolished starting 1st July 2025; voluntary objection procedure for initial refusal letters was available up to 30th June 2025
extra_information.customs_note: All travellers entering or leaving the EU with €10,000 or more in cash must declare customs
